say: A bigger connection pool can make your app less reliable. The database has one budget. Every app server spends from it.
show: A bigger connection pool can make your app less reliable. The database has one budget. Every app server spends from it.

say: A connection is the open line between app and database. Every question travels over one. Opening a new one is slow: say hello, log in first.
show: A connection is the open line between app and database. Every question travels over one. Opening a new one is slow: say hello, log in first.

say: If every request opens its own connection, hundreds of visitors can exhaust the budget. Imagine a database that allows a hundred connections.
show: If every request opens its own connection, hundreds of visitors can exhaust the budget. Imagine a database that allows a hundred connections.

say: At the limit, new connections are refused. Your users see errors.
show: At the limit, new connections are refused. Your users see errors.

say: A connection pool opens a few connections and keeps them open to reuse.
show: A connection pool opens a few connections and keeps them open to reuse.

say: Each request borrows one, asks its question, and hands it back. If all are busy, it waits in line, up to a timeout.
show: Each request borrows one, asks its question, and hands it back. If all are busy, it waits in line, up to a timeout.

say: Three servers with five connections each use fifteen. Count the total across every server, with room to spare.
show: Three servers with five connections each use fifteen. Count the total across every server, with room to spare.

say: Database libraries can manage the pool. Borrow, finish, return. A bigger pool is only useful if the database can afford it.
show: Database libraries can manage the pool. Borrow, finish, return. A bigger pool is only useful if the database can afford it.
